claim: New WHOOP apps start on a Sandbox tier of 10 members.
quote: Every new app starts on the Sandbox tier, which allows up to 10 WHOOP members to connect.
Sandbox 10 Build 100 Growth 1,000 Scale 5,000 Production Unlimited

claim: Tiers are requested one at a time; from Build onward half the current limit must be connected.
quote: Tiers are earned one at a time. You can only request the tier directly above your current one. From Build onward, moving up requires at least 50% of your current tier's member limit to be connected.

claim: Each request is reviewed by hand.
quote: Requests are reviewed manually, in the order they are received.

claim: Each request needs testing with at least one real member.
quote: Ensure that you have tested your app with at least one WHOOP member.

claim: Each request needs complete app details.
quote: In particular, make sure your App Name , Contact Email(s) , and Privacy Policy URL are filled in and accurate to accelerate the review.

claim: Each request needs adherence to WHOOP's brand guidelines.
quote: Verify your app adheres to the WHOOP Design and Brand Guidelines .

claim: Garmin's developer program is only for business use.
quote: There are no licensing or maintenance fees for access to the Garmin Connect Developer Program, but it is only for business use.

claim: Some metrics need a license fee or minimum device order for commercial use.
quote: Access to some metrics may require a license fee payment or minimum device order quantity for commercial use.
